title: Iron Sharpens Iron
summary: Courage is contagious. Together with other believers, we are moved to do things for the kingdom we would never dare alone.
exhortation: A simple proverb to start our morning. Courage is contagious. Unfortunately, so is cowardice. But when courage catches fire, it spreads. That's why we are meant to be in close community with other believers.

I've been really blessed reading To the Golden Shore, the story of the missionary Adoniram Judson, who brought the gospel to Burma when no one else dared to go. In those days such places were called lands of darkness, and it wasn't an exaggeration. It wasn't only that the gospel was unknown there. The land itself was unknown. It wasn't mapped. On a map it would be a black spot: nobody knew what was in there. Explorers hadn't gone far in, and there were few accounts. It was a dangerous, frightening mystery. And Judson decided to go.

Mankind is capable of inspiring each other to great heights of evil when we unite, like the Tower of Babel, a gigantic monument to human pride. But that's a twisted version of God's design. God's design is seen in the church, where we work together to accomplish beautiful things and inspire each other toward his kingdom and purposes, things we could never have imagined accomplishing alone. On our own, we often wouldn't have the motivation or the nerve. But surrounded by other believers and inspired by their faith and vision, we're moved to action.

That's how it was for Judson and his friends. They made a pact together to reach the unreached, and they did it. They went to places in India and Burma that had never heard the gospel and accomplished incredible things for the kingdom. That's how it's meant to be for us: bearing one another's burdens, fanning each other into flame, rekindling a passion for his kingdom, and ultimately modeling our Savior. There is no friend like Jesus. He knows every trouble and trial, and he never asks anything of us without also providing the power and the means to do it. Few things are as powerful as a friend who picks you up when you're down. So let's commit to doing life together with other believers.
prayer: Lord, light a fire in our souls to see a dark world lit up with your gospel. May it go to the ends of the earth. May it be the first thing out of our mouths and the passion of our souls. We hunger and thirst to see your name lifted high in our city, our homes, our state, our country and the world.
Open our eyes to the opportunities, and give us the courage to step out in faith. In Jesus' name.
